headline: Alphabet Plunges 12.2% on Disappointing Quarterly Results, Dragging Down Nasdaq
summary: Wall Street closed lower and the Nasdaq index fell 1.38%, pulled down by Google parent Alphabet, which tumbled 12.2% after quarterly financial results disappointed investors.
why: Alphabet is a heavyweight constituent of major US equity indexes. Sharp earnings-driven pullbacks in mega-cap technology firms exert outsized downward pressure on broad market benchmarks.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Disappointing earnings sparked direct selling in the stock.
